messages:
Alex S.: Quick question about the /v1/usage contract — the response includes prompt_tokens, completion_tokens and several cached_* fields. Are cached tokens supposed to be excluded from the "chargeable" value, and what exact field should SDKs rely on for billing? Need to lock this for the SDK and docs.

Maria Li: Spec note from design: chargeable_tokens = total_tokens - cached_prompt_tokens - cached_completion_tokens. We added cached_* for diagnostics but didn’t make the chargeable field explicit in the API response in the initial PR. I think we should add chargeable_tokens as a first-class required field.

Chris K.: If we add chargeable_tokens we should be careful about backwards compatibility. Older clients may parse total_tokens only. Do we want to keep total_tokens and add chargeable_tokens, or rename? Prefer additive change (add new field).

Samira: Agreed — additive. Proposal: API returns: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_prompt_tokens (optional), cached_completion_tokens (optional), total_tokens, chargeable_tokens (required). Also add a query param include_cache_details=true to opt in to cache fields for lower-bandwidth clients.

Alex S.: Sounds good. Example response we can standardize on (for SDK mapping):
```json
{
  "prompt_tokens": 120,
  "completion_tokens": 80,
  "cached_prompt_tokens": 20,
  "cached_completion_tokens": 0,
  "total_tokens": 200,
  "chargeable_tokens": 180
}
```

Maria Li: I'll update the OpenAPI file and add the new required chargeable_tokens field. Will mark cached_* as nullable/optional and document include_cache_details.

Chris K.: Two follow-ups: 1) If chargeable_tokens is missing (older servers), SDKs should fall back to computing total - (cached_prompt + cached_completion) when cached fields exist, or default to total_tokens as a worst-case (billing conservative). 2) Add unit tests verifying chargeable calc when partial cache info is returned. I'll add both in my PR.

Samira: Minor edge: cached tokens come from prefix/KV hits which can be probabilistic in some setups (partial hits). We should specify chargeable_tokens is an integer and rounding behavior: server must round down fractional savings and include a note in docs. Also, if include_cache_details=false, chargeable_tokens must still be present.

reconcile-bot: Billing ingest schema v2 deployed to staging (schema id: billing-v2-2026-03). Ingest will look for chargeable_tokens as primary charge field.

Alex S.: Great — two action items: Maria update OpenAPI + docs, Chris add SDK fallback and tests, Samira add docs note about rounding and partial hits. I'll coordinate with billing to confirm they use chargeable_tokens as single source-of-truth. Please drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:

Maria Li: Opening draft PR now — will ping when ready.

Chris K.: I'll start the SDK change today, will add fallback and tests and ping for review.

Samira: I'll write the rounding note in the docs and add an example of partial cache miss.

Alex S.: Thanks, everyone — locking for sprint.
